messages:
Avery (People Ops): Quick note  Raul Kim is joining Redwood as Senior Inference Engineer (Team Lead) starting Mon May 6. Hell backfill Priya and report to Cheng Li. :tada:

Cheng Li: Welcome Raul! Ill share a 30/60/90 ramp plan and set weekly 1:1s. Please add him to #inference and the inference-runner repo.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Adding Raul to oncall and infra groups today. If anyone needs him on a specific week (1-4), ping me.

Marie (Eng-ML): Ill schedule a model-ops onboarding walkthrough and share our playbook and dashboards. Raul  what timezone are you in? I can do async notes if needed.

Raul Kim: Hi all  excited to join. Im PST and prefer mornings. Happy to take the May 8 architecture sync.

Noah (People Ops): Laptop + peripherals ordered. IT will reach out for VPN and workstation access. Slack and email provisioned.

Tia (Recruiter): Offer docs & Greenhouse record live if you need IDs. Thanks for the smooth handoff.

Cheng Li: Small ask  please avoid major runtime/infra rollouts during his first week to minimize noise. Urgent fixes still go through.

Alex (Eng-Platform): Noted  well postpone the kernel swap scheduled that week.

Avery (People Ops): Scheduling a 20m "Welcome & Admin" on day 1 (benefits, security training, badging) and a short company intro on Fri May 10. Please add a one-line note to the onboarding doc after any 1:1s or intros.

Hirebot: New hire profile published to /handbook/new-hires and pinned in #new-hires.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Will block a 15m ops sync and add Raul to the rota. Welcome aboard! :wave:

Raul Kim: Thanks everyone  looking forward to getting started.
